body.name: Common strictly positive law
body.construction: Define \(p_{\star}\) through the \(G_{1\star}\)-factorization by \(p_{\star}(c=1)=1/2\), \(p_{\star}(a=1\mid c=0)=1/4\), \(p_{\star}(a=1\mid c=1)=3/4\), \([p_{\star}(b=1\mid a,c)]_{(a,c)}=((1/8,3/8),(5/8,7/8))\), and \([p_{\star}(d=1\mid a,b)]_{(a,b)}=((1/5,2/5),(3/5,4/5))\), using complements for value zero and row-major order for binary parent tuples. Equivalently, the same law has the \(G_{2\star}\)-factorization \(p_{\star}(d=1)=1/2\), \([p_{\star}(a=1\mid d)]_{d=0,1}=(19/80,61/80)\), \([p_{\star}(b=1\mid a,d)]_{(a,d)}=((9/61,6/19),(13/19,52/61))\), and \([p_{\star}(c=1\mid a,b)]_{(a,b)}=((5/26,1/2),(1/2,21/26))\).
